module: "Structured" editing form of a pacenote in the rally editor. It displays a preview of the text and audio files, then the sections Caution, Modifiers Before (preMod1/preMod2), Corner (intensity descriptor, direction, shape, signed steps, length mode, slow corner release type), Modifiers After (postMod1/postMod2) and Distance. Modifiers are chosen by menu or by text search, with a list of the most recently used (10 max). The options come from the notebook's text composer configuration. Used by pacenoteForm.
notes: The configuration (types, modifiers, shapes, descriptors) is loaded at the first draw after a clear().
Call clear() when the displayed pacenote changes, otherwise the form keeps the old one's data.

draw.desc: Draws the whole structured form for the given pacenote (loads the configuration if needed).

pacenoteToolsWindow.desc: Pacenote tools window, stored for refreshes.

clear.desc: Resets the form's internal state (configuration, options, search states, active window).
